name: Black Diamond
source: The follows Lydia. An 18 year old girl who's about to begin her first year in a prestigious college of New York. - She's spent all her life studying and has no experience of the "real world". - Will your choices change her life for the better? for the worse? or will there be no change at all?
translation: 接下来是莉迪亚。一名18岁女孩即将在纽约一所著名大学开始第一年的学习。- 她一生都在学习，对“现实世界”没有任何体验。- 你的选择会让她的生活变得更好吗？变得更糟？或者根本不会有任何变化？
